Priority: P1 | Area: agent | Labels: feat,area:agent,P1 | Milestone: v0.1-integration | RFC: none | Task: AI-0042

Scope: implement an experimental localhost-only ModelProvider in bitty-ai-slice (pressure-test crate), proving a real HTTP round-trip to a local Ollama/OpenAI-compatible endpoint through the runtime ModelProvider seam. Motivation: provider selection (AI-0030) can now select; this proves selection output can drive a real (local, no-cloud) inference endpoint. Chosen because it couples with nothing else (no R1/R2/R3, no consent, no context, no prompt changes).

Hard constraints:
- bitty-ai-runtime/src UNTOUCHED (stays std-only, zero deps). New code lives in bitty-ai-slice only.
- Zero new dependencies (Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock dep-diff must be empty): raw HTTP/1.1 over std::net::TcpStream, hand-rolled minimal JSON build/extract, fail-closed on malformed responses.
- Localhost-only: refuse non-loopback hosts (127.0.0.0/8, ::1) with a typed fail-closed error; plain HTTP only (no TLS in std); connect+read timeouts mandatory.
- No secrets in code: local Ollama needs no key; any key-bearing OpenAI-compatible path takes caller-supplied value only, never hardcoded, never logged.
- Tests: deterministic unit tests against an in-test std TcpListener stub server; conformance through Agent::run_turn proving selection->provider->turn wiring; any live-Ollama test MUST be \#[ignore] (never runs in CI).
- No AIQ closure; AIQ-33 (gate model) mechanism stays open; docs: slice README +1 line only.
- Independent review required before completion (fresh reviewer, NEEDS-FIX->fix->re-review until APPROVE).
title: Local provider vertical slice (Ollama/OpenAI-compatible, localhost-only, slice-side experiment)

Hard constraints:
